title: Against the higher timeframe
prompt: It is 09:50 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: The 5m looks clean. Before you act on it, check what the Daily and 4H are doing, and what is sitting above price.
intro.advanced: 09:50 ET. A clean 5m. What does the higher timeframe say?

whyNot.label: buying the 5m setup
whyNot.why: A sweep, displacement and an FVG are all there, and price is climbing straight into 1H supply on a Daily and 4H downtrend. The lower timeframe is a rally inside the larger move, not a reversal of it.

whyNot.label: shorting it here
whyNot.why: Nothing has confirmed down yet. The supply is a reason not to buy, and it takes its own sweep and displacement to short.

reference.summary: A valid-looking 5m long (sweep, displacement, gap) into 1H supply, on higher timeframes that are making lower highs and lower lows. The conflict is the whole lesson: stand aside, or wait for the higher timeframe to speak.

bias.why: Lower highs and lower lows on the Daily and 4H. The overnight dip and the open's rally are both inside that downtrend.

decision.why: The long conflicts with the higher timeframe and runs into supply: no trade, or wait to see whether supply holds. A short isn't there yet.

take.why: The 5m is valid and the context is against it.

draw.why: The higher timeframe is drawn lower: the previous day low is the pool, and the rally is a retrace.

location.why: Price is rallying into the premium of the leg down, where supply sits.

next_objective.why: Price was drawn to the previous day low (21,062.25). The question is where price was likely to be pulled, not what the next candle would do. A previous-day extreme is also a pool of buy-side or sell-side liquidity, so that answer is right on the side, if less exact.

annotations.label: 1H bearish FVG above price
annotations.why: Higher-timeframe supply, directly in the path. A long has to trade through it, and in a downtrend it's where rallies tend to end.
annotations.decisionNote: This is the reason there's no trade: the target is blocked by the thing the trend wants to defend.

annotations.label: Overnight low 21,087.5
annotations.why: Sell-side liquidity, swept. A sweep on the lower timeframe is fine; here it's a reason to be careful, not to buy.

annotations.label: 5m bullish FVG from the displacement
annotations.why: A clean gap in the wrong direction against the higher timeframe. It's valid as a pattern and not as a trade.
annotations.whyNot: A good 5m model against a bearish 4H inside 1H supply isn't an edge; it's a counter-trend scalp.

annotations.label: Previous day low 21,062.25
annotations.why: Where the higher timeframe is drawn. That's where the bigger move wants to go.

confluences.label: Sell-side liquidity swept
confluences.why: Real, and in a downtrend sweeps of lows often just extend the move.

confluences.label: Displacement up through the last 5m high
confluences.why: Valid on the 5m and counter to the 4H.

confluences.label: Bullish 5m FVG as an entry
confluences.why: A good entry model for a bad idea.

lookFor: Check what's above price before you go long, and what's below before you go short.
Higher timeframe first. A perfect lower-timeframe model against it is a counter-trend trade and should be priced like one.
When the two disagree, 'no trade' and 'wait for the higher timeframe to confirm' are both good answers.
